sources.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 4.5
sources.evidence: Dated October 15, 2025 and announces availability that day. Describes a small, fast model for low-latency assistants, coding, computer use and parallel subagents; distributes it through Claude products and hosted APIs. Reopened October 27, 2026: the small-model and performance comparisons provide no nominal total or active size and do not identify Haiku 4.5 as a variant of a named, sized base.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 4.5 model overview
sources.evidence: Maps Claude Haiku 4.5 and its convenience alias to claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Lists October 15, 2025 release, 200K context, manual extended thinking, and text/image input with text output. Current lineup comparison has no model-parameter counts. Reopened October 27, 2026: comparison columns are context, maximum output, price, thinking, default effort and knowledge cutoff; no total or activated-parameter column.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 4.5 System Card (October 2025)
sources.evidence: Names Anthropic and its small, fast hybrid reasoning model. Describes extended thinking and 200K context, and evaluates computer use, MCP and general tool use. The searchable card contains no parameter-count or architecture disclosure.

sources.title: Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models
sources.evidence: July 6, 2026 interpretability paper. Methods describe transformer residual-stream layers and next-token unembedding; the methods section explicitly applies the analysis to Haiku 4.5 as well as Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.5. Haiku 4.5 has its own intervention results. Does not disclose production parameter counts or dense versus MoE structure. Reopened October 27, 2026: J-space sparsity and lens coordinates describe the interpretability method, not learned-parameter totals or active counts; the auxiliary fine-tuned reconstructor is derived from the subject model, not a disclosed sized base for Haiku 4.5.

sources.title: Tool use with Claude
sources.evidence: Defines function calling and explicitly lists Claude Haiku 4.5 in its tool-use token table for auto/none and any/tool tool choices.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing, including visual content. PDF input is processed using vision; the Haiku 4.5 overview identifies the model as active legacy.

sources.title: Anthropic's Claude Haiku 4.5 on Google Cloud
sources.evidence: Exact model provider documentation explicitly lists image/PDF/text input, text output, 200,000 input tokens, function calling, extended thinking and October 15, 2025 release.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Terms governing Anthropic API access grant service-use permission, restrict reverse engineering and reserve intellectual-property rights. Supports the descriptive proprietary classification for the hosted model rather than an open-weight license.

sources.title: Anthropic's Transparency Hub: Claude Haiku 4.5
sources.evidence: Haiku 4.5 section lists Claude.ai, Anthropic API, Bedrock and Vertex AI access and describes pretraining/post-training. It supplies no numerical total or active parameter counts or dense/MoE designation. Later model comparison material provides behavioral evaluation comparisons. Reopened October 27, 2026: the exact Haiku 4.5 training description still identifies generic pretraining and post-training, without a named, sized base or numerical model size.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Attempted later sibling card for exact Haiku 4.5 comparison disclosures. Browser fetch failed due to document size; direct retrieval returned HTTP 403. Not used as technical evidence.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Attempted later comparison card. Indexed excerpts include Haiku 4.5 behavioral results, but full browser fetch exceeded size limits and direct retrieval returned HTTP 403. Not used to establish numerical model specifications.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 system card
sources.evidence: Parent retrieved the complete 144-page PDF from the working Anthropic redirect and searched its full text. Exact Haiku4.5 comparisons concern behavioral evaluations; parameter terms concern inference controls and do not supply production model counts or dense/MoE topology.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.5 system card
sources.evidence: Parent retrieved the complete 153-page PDF from the working Anthropic redirect and searched its full text. Exact Haiku4.5 comparisons concern behavioral evaluations; parameter terms concern inference controls and do not supply production model counts or dense/MoE topology.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. This is first-party evidence about weight availability independent of the existence of a hosted API; the paper's benchmark models are newer Claude versions.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 4.5 system card — fresh primary retrieval
sources.evidence: Fresh complete 39-page card retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:11:46Z; independently searched its full extracted text and inspected sections 1 and 1.1. It describes a small model, comparison with predecessor Haiku 3.5, proprietary pretraining data, and post-training/fine-tuning, but gives no nominal total, activated-parameter count or named sized base. The predecessor relationship does not establish shared weights or model size.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 system card — fresh later comparison check
sources.evidence: Fresh complete 144-page card retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:11:48Z; independently searched full extracted text for parameter, billion, million, active, dense, MoE and lineage terms and inspected the exact Haiku 4.5 comparison tables. Table 4.1.1.A columns report harmless-response rates; other exact-model comparisons are behavioral/capability results. Parameter mentions are effort/inference controls, with no nominal total or activated count for Haiku 4.5 and no named sized base.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.5 system card — fresh later comparison check
sources.evidence: Fresh complete 153-page card retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:18:49Z; independently searched full extracted text and inspected exact Haiku 4.5 comparisons. Table 2.6.A columns are agentic-search scores with context-management settings; Qwen3-Embedding-8B in its methodology is an external search tool, not Haiku 4.5 lineage or model size. Other parameter terms concern effort/sampling controls, and approximately 3 million SAE features describe an interpretability auxiliary, not Haiku 4.5 parameters. No total or activated-parameter specification is supplied.

sources.title: Incompressible Knowledge Probes: Estimating Black-Box LLM Parameter Counts via Factual Capacity (v2)
sources.evidence: Fresh parameter-count search surfaced external IKP estimates, followed to the original paper and its July 5, 2026 revision. The paper explicitly describes coarse effective-capacity prediction bands; the full-results rows for claude-haiku-4.5 and its thinking mode leave Params, IKP Pred. and Arch blank. Its inferred lineage table classifies Haiku 3.5 to Haiku 4.5 as independent. This is external black-box research, not an Anthropic nominal size or explicit developer lineage disclosure, so no numerical count is adopted.

name.note: Official name, mapped to the exact dated API snapshot.

developer.note: Developer identified by the launch announcement and system card.

family.note: Catalog slug for the named Claude Haiku product family; retained.

release_date.note: Announcement explicitly says available that day. The 20251001 snapshot suffix is not the public launch date; Bedrock separately lists October 16.

open_weights.note: Anthropic explicitly says Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Exact Haiku4.5 materials describe hosted distribution; the classification does not rely solely on API access.

license.note: Descriptive classification of restricted hosted-model access, not an SPDX license or a claim that model weights are distributed.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit found no developer-published nominal total in the exact card, launch, current specifications, transparency entry, interpretability paper or later Haiku 5.5/Opus 4.5 cards. No explicit relationship to a named, sized base supports a lineage inference. The external IKP lead measures coarse effective capacity rather than publishing a developer model specification; the null does not depend on requiring an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Rechecked active counts separately. Current documentation comparisons have no activated-parameter column; full-text later Haiku 5.5 and Opus 4.5 cards compare behavioral results without an active count. Effort controls, lens dimensions, SAE features and the Qwen3-Embedding-8B search tool do not measure Haiku 4.5 active parameters. Neither total-equals-active nor a dense/MoE assumption is supported.

architecture.note: First-party interpretability methods describe transformer residual-stream and unembedding computation, then explicitly report Haiku 4.5 experiments. This establishes the broad architecture only; dense versus MoE and complete architectural dimensions remain undisclosed.

context_window.note: 200K tokens for this exact model, confirmed in the system card and current model specifications.

modalities.note: Text/image to text is model-native; PDF is an officially supported input document format processed with vision. Voice dictation and text-to-speech in Claude products do not establish native audio modality.

reasoning.note: Supports manually enabled extended thinking; hybrid reasoning includes a non-thinking mode.

tool_call.note: Exact model is documented for function/tool calling and evaluated with tools.

description.value: Small, fast hybrid reasoning model for coding, computer use, responsive assistants, and parallel subagents.
description.note: Replaces the catalog wording with explicitly supported use cases; classification was not independently established as the intended product positioning in the primary launch materials.

patch.description: Small, fast hybrid reasoning model for coding, computer use, responsive assistants, and parallel subagents.

sources.label: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities

patch.notes: Transformer architecture is supported by first-party interpretability research explicitly studying Haiku 4.5. Anthropic has not disclosed nominal total or active parameter counts, dense-versus-MoE structure, or a named, sized base. The dated API suffix precedes the public October 15, 2025 launch.

summary: October 27 parameter-only re-audit independently rechecked the exact Haiku 4.5 card, current launch/specification/transparency/research sources, and fresh full texts of later Haiku 5.5 and Opus 4.5 comparison cards. Neither nominal total nor active parameters nor a named sized base was disclosed. Followed the external IKP estimation lead to its original revised paper; it does not establish an Anthropic model specification. Both counts remain explicitly null/undisclosed; all other field assessments are preserved.
